page.layout: One printed title page, a copper-engraved frame with the title set in an oval cartouche. Above the cartouche: an engraved eagle, owl, birds and a portrait medallion, with no text. Inside the cartouche: 6 lines of title, "Cum Privilegio." in script. Below the cartouche, on a banner: 2 lines of imprint. Under the banner: the engraver's signature line.
page.notes: Engraved title page. The frame contains an eagle with spread wings above a central portrait medallion, an owl and two birds at the sides, and fruit and foliage ornament around the cartouche. The bottom of the scan carries a blue library stamp ("nororum" and an oval stamp), which is left out. The engraver's line "C.D.Sculps." is read from the small print under the banner and may be slightly unclear.
